question: Who observed the Pratyaksh Karyawahi Diwas (Direct Action Day) on 16 August 1946?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Muslim League**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On** 16 August 1946**, **Muslim League **called for a **“Direct Action Day” **under the **leadership **of **Mohammad Ali Jinnah**.
 
• The **aim **of **Direct Action Day **by the **Muslim League **was to **get Pakistan **through **violent **means if **not by legal means**.
 
• **Mohammad Ali Jinnah **proclaimed that we shall have **“either a divided India or a destroyed India”.**
 
• **Direct Action Day**, also known as the **1946 Calcutta Killings **as this was a day of **widespread communal rioting **between **Muslims and Hindus in Calcutta**, **Bengal province **of **British India**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Central Sikh League **was a **political party **of the **Sikhs**. It was **founded in Amritsar **on **19 December 1919**. The First **Leader/President **was **Sardar Bahadur Sardar**.
 
• **Christian League **is a **charitable foundation **for social harmony, social justice, and social development.
